headline: Blanche 🥶🍆 Trump’s ex-lawyer BARELY confirmed AG 😩🔨
text: Todd Blanche 🥶🧑‍⚖️ – Trump’s hush-money DEFENDER 🍆💰 – just SQUEAKED into AG chair with a 50-49 SNAIL RACE 🐌🔥! Two GOP Senators Collins 🤡👵 and Murkowski 🧊🐟 joined the Dems to say “NAH BRO” 🚫, but Louisiana’s Cassidy 🐊🗳️ cast the TIEBREAKER that saved Blanche’s bacon 🥓😤! The vote ENDS a MONTHS-long Senate standoff between GOP holdouts and the Trump White House 🏛️🍊. Blanche has been ACTING AG since APRIL 🌧️📅 and now he’s the TOP COP of the whole nation 🇺🇸🕵️‍♂️. After the gavel dropped, Blanche said he’s “deeply HONOURED” by Trump’s trust, basically giving the president a big sloppy KISS 💋🧎‍♂️. GOP critics grilled him over the Jeffrey Epstein files 📜🍆 and the $1.8BN “anti-weaponisation” slush fund 💰🛡️ that some fear would pay 6 January rioters 🏛️💥. Blanche promised to SCRAP the fund after the grilling, but nobody knows if that’s legally BINDING or if Trump will just rename it “Operation MAGA Money” 💵🪄 later. Collins worried about Blanche’s role settling Trump’s $10BN IRS beef 💼🧾, but ultimately trusted him to give the prez “candid” advice – aka “yes sir, no sir, three bags full sir” 🤡🙇. Cassidy said it’s NOT a referendum on Trump, just Blanche in “specific circumstances” – translation: “the least bad option on the menu” 🍔😬. Schumer warned Blanche will be Trump’s “excuse on a silver platter” for more corruption 🍽️🦹, while Grassley praised his “patience, compassion, tenacity” – basically calling him the Senate’s new GOLDEN RETRIEVER 🐕✨. Either way, Blanche is now officially the nation’s CHIEF LAW ENFORCER 🛡️🍑 and the DOJ just got a whole lot spicier 🌶️💦!
